name: app-crypto-wallet-red-phone-on-black-gravel
title: Red Crypto Wallet on Black Gravel
whatItIs: A tilted phone with a full red wallet screen (large balance, bar-and-line chart) planted in a slope of black gravel, red gradient sky, and a tagline at lower left.
whatItMeans: Red-on-black feels bold and high-stakes, suiting money and risk. Physical grit adds realism and tension.
techniques: One accent hue used for the whole UI and backdrop
Rough natural texture against smooth UI
Particles dissolving from the phone's base
Striped bar-chart background behind a line
Type with mixed weights and tones in the tagline

vocabulary.definition: Small fragments breaking away from an object's edge.
Setting smooth digital forms on rough material.
Using the brand color across both subject and backdrop.
